killedBy: particles under reduced motion (issue #651) draws ONE particle, not the whole coincident burst
why: Restores the whole burst at one point. The material is additively blended, so N coincident particles at opacity 1 sum past every channel and clip: measured through the gallery on the kill moment, the 24-particle reduced burst rendered as a small WHITE core over an unchanged background -- orange pixel count flat at the pre-explosion baseline of 5180 while full motion reached 18689 at the same frame. So the reduced treatment was not a calmer explosion but a white FLASH, which is the opposite of what the preference asks for, plus 23 meshes adding saturation rather than information.
